_comment: Third-party Claude Code plugins this team expects on every machine. scripts/sync.sh installs anything missing and reports drift; it never force-changes an installed version, because `claude plugin install` has no flag to request one. "version" is therefore an advisory record of what the team agreed on, semver only — omit it for a plugin the marketplace versions by its own commit sha, which changes on every upstream commit and would warn forever. Adding a plugin or changing a pinned version is a reviewed decision, per the root CLAUDE.md's cross-cutting rules.
